verdict.rationale: Gitleaks documents a baseline mode: running detect with --baseline-path ignores old findings and reports only new issues. It also documents per-rule allowlists that suppress false positives. Together these deliver the story directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of baseline and allowlist behavior, and evidence of per-finding ignore mechanisms beyond rule allowlists.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can baseline or ignore existing and false-positive findings so only new issues alert

citations.quote: After running the detect command with the --baseline-path parameter, report output (findings.json) will only contain new issues.
When using a baseline, gitleaks will ignore any old findings that are present in the baseline.
You can define multiple allowlists for a rule to reduce false positives. A finding will be ignored if _ANY_ [[rules.allowlists]] matches.
